summary: BW LPG, the Singapore-listed and NYSE-listed gas carrier, disclosed via 6-K a press release announcing that its 52%-owned subsidiary BW LPG India agreed to sell the 2008-built vessel BW Loyalty for continued trading at a price in the low US$80 million. The disposal is expected to generate a roughly US$52 million gain on a 100% basis and net cash proceeds of about US$66 million after taxes and costs. Delivery to the buyer is scheduled on completion of the current time charter and no later than December 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named; watch charter expiry timing and proceeds deployment.
